rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: few - the palm parkway; one tree per car-park island end (zone 106 -> about 80)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The credit union and recycling block's ten builder trees go (magnolias, a row of three eucalyptus against the CMU wall, two torrey pines, a queen palm 1.2 m from the pylon sign that would hide it); two come back on their own spots, the car park's island ends.

trees.why: the south island end of the credit union's car park, by the agaves: the island-end tree, shade over the parked cars
the north island end of the same car park, by the lot light: the other island-end tree, the same species so the lot reads as one
